name: Source provenance
rule: Every input row carries an official URL read on a stamped date; no aggregator

name: Leakage control
rule: Every forecast uses only data timestamped before kickoff; point-in-time join
status: partial: forecasts use weeks already completed

name: Chronological split
rule: Train/validation/holdout fixed before results are seen

name: Calibration
rule: Reliability slope in 0.8-1.2 and intercept |a|<0.05 on >=500 forecasts

name: Skill evidence
rule: Brier skill vs flat control > 0 with 95% CI lower bound > 0

name: Multiplicity
rule: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across the registered family
status: not met: best Holm p=0.030 is a non-strategy exposure

name: Prospective replication
rule: >=200 bets recorded live before kickoff after registration

name: Market benchmark
rule: Closing line captured with timestamp; CLV computed
status: blocked: no official market feed in repo (FLAG-P1)

name: Joint evidence (parlays)
rule: Directly validated joint probability and operator void/push rules

name: Staking separation
rule: Signal score and staking P&L reported as separate columns

name: Availability point-in-time
rule: Injury/depth snapshot with hash and timestamp before kickoff

name: Injury/depth ablation
rule: Same model with and without availability features, chronological holdouts
